title: PSL2 two-subset fiber and mod-2 footprint bridge
purpose: Independently analyze the all-odd local two-line fiber as PSL2(q) on 2-subsets of P1(q), connect its modular permutation structure to the W(3,q) point module and footprint kernel, test exact formulas at new anchors where feasible, and promote only proof-safe consequences into the frontier/manuscripts/site.
boundary: No all-odd binary-rank theorem without a complete module-theoretic or combinatorial proof; distinguish PSL2/PGL2 and characteristic-zero/characteristic-two modules; preserve q=11 and Hoffman distance firewalls.
